# Image

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

An image element that displays JPEG or PNG images in the PDF

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IAltTextProvider`, `IRoleProvider`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new Image()
```

- [`KeepResolution`](#keepresolution): When `true`, the image is embedded at its source resolution regardless of `MaxImageDpi`.
- [`MaintainAspectRatio`](#maintainaspectratio): Whether to maintain aspect ratio (ignored for Fill mode)

- [`Width`](#width): Desired display width in points (null = auto)

### `AltText`

```csharp
string AltText { get; set; }
```

Alternate text description for accessibility. When the document opts into `AccessibilityMode.PdfUa1`, this populates the `/Alt` entry on the structure element wrapping the image. Required by PDF/UA for non-decorative figures.

### `FilePath`

```csharp
string FilePath { get; set; }
```

Path to image file (mutually exclusive with ImageData)

ImageFitMode FitMode { get; set; }
```

How to fit the image within bounds

float? Height { get; set; }
```

Desired display height in points (null = auto-scale)

### `ImageData`

```csharp
byte[] ImageData { get; set; }
```

Raw image data (mutually exclusive with FilePath)

> A list you can change.

### `IsDecorative`

```csharp
bool IsDecorative { get; set; }
```

When `true`, the image is purely decorative and should be tagged as `/Artifact` with no alt-text warning. Set this explicitly for decorative borders, dividers, and background imagery so authors can distinguish "no alt by mistake" from "no alt is correct".

### `KeepResolution`

```csharp
bool KeepResolution { get; set; }
```

When `true`, the image is embedded at its source resolution regardless of `MaxImageDpi`. If the same image is placed more than once, one placement with this set keeps the whole embedded copy at full resolution.

### `MaintainAspectRatio`

```csharp
bool MaintainAspectRatio { get; set; }
```

Whether to maintain aspect ratio (ignored for Fill mode)

### `SemanticRole`

```csharp
SemanticRole SemanticRole { get; }
```

*read-only*

The structure role in a tagged PDF: `Figure` when the element has alternative text, otherwise `Artifact`. It is always `Artifact` when `IsDecorative` is set.

### `Width`

```csharp
float? Width { get; set; }
```

Desired display width in points (null = auto)
